rule.title: Automated Pre-Commit and CI Quality Gates
rule.statement: Git commits and CI builds must enforce automated quality gates: ESLint (zero errors), TypeScript type-check (tsc --noEmit), and automated unit tests.
rule.rationale: Allowing broken types or unlinted code into the main branch blocks team velocity and leads to broken deployments.
rule.implementation_guidance: Configure Husky with lint-staged for pre-commit. Configure GitHub Actions to run lint, typecheck, and test on every PR.

forbidden.example: Committing with git commit -n (--no-verify) to bypass failing type checks.

preferred.example: npx lint-staged (running eslint --fix && prettier --write) on staged files prior to commit.

source.evidence_quote: The commit stage should run fast automated unit tests, linting, and compile checks. If any check fails, the build fails immediately, giving instant feedback.
